title: David Ferrie's mysterious death

tellings.quote: He commits suicide or is suicided under mysterious circumstances during the investigation into the Kennedy assassination.

plain: A man named David Ferrie died in New Orleans in 1967 under mysterious circumstances, in the middle of the investigation into the Kennedy assassination that the story ties to Jim Garrison. A researcher named Peter Levenda tells Michels that Ferrie either "commits suicide or is suicided", leaving open whether someone killed him to keep him quiet.
